analysis.title: Oil Data Digest | Europe: Weekly Oil Stock Summary
key_insights: Total oil inventories (crude plus products) across the US, ARA, Japan, Singapore and Fujairah built by 13.2 mln bbls last week, or +1.89 mb/d versus a 10-year average of -0.02 mb/d.
Crude stocks built by 3.6 mln bbls (+0.51 mb/d versus a 10-year average of -0.12 mb/d), driven by builds in Japan and NW Europe.
Refined product stocks built by 9.7 mln bbls (+1.38 mb/d versus a 10-year average of +0.10 mb/d), driven by a build in the US.

Gasoline stocks built by 4.4 mln bbls (+0.63 mb/d versus average +0.17 mb/d), driven by the US. Distillate stocks built by 2.9 mln bbls (+0.41 mb/d versus average -0.03 mb/d), also driven by the US. Fuel oil stocks built by 1.8 mln bbls (+0.26 mb/d versus average +0.04 mb/d), driven by Singapore.

Regionally, US total oil stocks including the SPR built by 9.1 mln bbls and ARA total stocks built by 3.2 mln bbls. Japan crude stocks built by 1.9 mln bbls. Singapore product stocks drew by 0.4 mln bbls and Fujairah product stocks drew by 0.6 mln bbls.

US total crude stocks (commercial plus SPR) built by 0.2 mln bbls WoW to 694.2 mln bbls. Commercial crude built by 3.4 mln bbls to 417.8 mln bbls, offset by a 3.2 mln bbl SPR draw (about 0.5 mbpd) that took SPR stocks to 276.4 mln bbls.
Cushing stocks drew by 1.2 mln bbls WoW to 26.2 mln bbls. US crude production rose 20 kbpd WoW to 14.03 mbpd, a record in the weekly EIA data.

US crude exports rose 1.0 mbpd WoW to 4.5 mbpd (11% above the 5Y seasonal average, 8% higher YoY). Crude imports fell 1.1 mbpd to 5.6 mbpd, the lowest in almost 5 months and 17% below the 5Y seasonal average. Net crude imports fell by over 2 mbpd, yet commercial crude still built.

US refinery runs fell 130 kbpd WoW to 16.9 mbpd, led by PADD 2 (-90 kbpd, utilisation down 2.0pp to 94.9%) and PADD 4 (-30 kbpd to 600 kbpd, lowest in almost 6 months). Overall utilisation rose 0.5pp to 95.7%, the highest in just over 2 months and 6% above the 5Y seasonal average.
US gasoline stocks built 5.2 mln bbls WoW to 216.0 mln bbls, the highest in almost 5 months and 2% above the 5Y seasonal average. Implied gasoline demand was broadly flat WoW.
US distillate stocks built 1.6 mln bbls WoW to 104.9 mln bbls, 7% below the 5Y seasonal average. Implied middle distillate demand rebounded 11% WoW, which slowed the pace of the build.
